critical_code_review_comments: Refactor is clean: state.py/models.py/cue.py/artwork.py/analysis_service.py/scan_service.py have clear single responsibilities and server.py is down to 697 lines. Consider moving the remaining route handlers for /api/admin/scan and /api/admin/analyze_all into a routes_admin.py to further reduce server.py when it grows again.

AnalysisOverviewBar polls every 4s unconditionally while admin dashboard is open — fine for a self-hosted single-admin app, but consider pausing when document.hidden or when counts.running+pending==0 for N consecutive polls to cut idle chatter.

Previous iteration note still valid: _scan_tasks and the in-flight analyze queue are in-process memory — a backend restart loses task state. Acceptable for single-replica self-hosted deployment, but worth a README note.
analysis_overview iterates the full mixes collection on every call — replace with $group aggregate on analysis_status when library grows past a few thousand mixes.
